title: AthleteIdentity
description: Identity-plane record for one athlete in one class. `athlete_id` is a class-scoped pseudonym minted by the backend at join time; it is the ONLY identifier that appears in telemetry. The account link (Apple/Google/email subject) is stored server-side and is deliberately absent from this contract.
